set -eu
echo TOOL_METADATA
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
command -v dmesg
command -v timeout || true
command -v setsid || true

dmesg --help 2>&1 || true
echo TIMEOUT_HELP
timeout --help 2>&1 || true
